Hi Elena, hi Priya,

quick one before I forget. A haulier contact of mine was chatting yesterday and said the Kestrel container could be stuck at Genoa for up to three weeks. Apparently the port is a bit of a mess at the moment, but that's just what I heard over the phone.

I can't confirm this, I'm only passing it on. Might be nothing, might be worth keeping an eye on if either of you has a line to the forwarder.

Tom
